overview_description.description: Stratify, Inc. offers electronic discovery and data investigation solutions for the legal market. It provides Legal Discovery service, an electronic discovery solution offered as an ASP service that enables law firms, corporations, and attorneys to organize document collections, flag privilege and prevent inadvertent waivers, find key documents and players, and track productions and matters; and Document Analytics to search, analyze, and report on documents with various types of embedded metadata, including comments, tracked changes, speaker notes, and fast-save data. The company also offers Visual Email Analytics to analyze complex email collections and visually represent relationships between senders, receivers, and intermediary correspondents in graphical email maps to identify important message units. In addition, it provides Stratify eVantage, an on-premises eDiscovery early case assessment solution that safeguards corporate proprietary information. The company serves litigators and corporate counsels. Stratify, Inc. was formerly known as PurpleYogi. The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Mountain View, California with an office and data center in London. Stratify, Inc. operates as a subsidiary of Iron Mountain Inc.
